556f66dce723bcd061ed.headline: UMashaba ubuyela esikhundleni sokuba ngucwaningi eGoli
556f66dce723bcd061ed.dek: Umholi we-ActionSA ukhethwe emhlanganweni wophiko lwezepolitiki, kulandelwa izinkulumo zemifelandawonye phakathi kwe-ANC, i-ActionSA ne-EFF.
556f66dce723bcd061ed.why: Abahlali baseGoli manje banosodolophu ovela ku-ActionSA, okhethwe ngamakhansela ngemuva kwezingxoxo zemifelandawonye phakathi kwamaqembu amaningi.
paragraphs: U-Herman Mashaba ubuyele esikhundleni sokuba ngumphathi wosodolophu eDolobheni laseGoli, emva kokuba amakhansela emkhethile emhlanganweni woMkhandlu eGoli Council Chamber ngoLwesihlanu mhla zingama-27 kuNovemba. Unqobe uHelen Zille weDemocratic Alliance (DA), iqembu ayeyimenenja yalo njengesodolophu kusukela ngo-2016 kuya ku-2019. Manje uhola i-ActionSA.

Amakhansela avotele ngemuva kwemibiko yesivumelwano semifelandawonye ebandakanya i-African National Congress (ANC), i-ActionSA ne-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF). I-DA inqobe izihlalo eziningi okhethweni luhulumeni wesigodi mhla zine kuNovemba, ngezihlalo ezingama-91 kwezingama-270, ilandelwa yi-ANC enezingama-63 ne-ActionSA enezingama-43, kodwa yehlulekile ukuthola iningi eliphelele.
U-Zille wayeseshilo ukuthi izingxoxo zemifelandawonye zemizuzu yokugcina zazisaphithizela ngaphambi kokuba kuvotelwe, futhi wenqabe ukusho ukuthi i-DA yayixoxisana ne-ActionSA noma cha.

3fac87ffab63d33ab224.headline: Itheku laseKapa lifaka iziteringi eziyi-14 zokuthumela izithelo phesheya
3fac87ffab63d33ab224.dek: I-Transnet Port Terminals ithi ukuthengwa kwemishini engama-R83 wezigidi kuhloswe ngakho ukwehlisa ukuma kwamakhreyini ngesikhathi kulayishwa imikhumbi.
3fac87ffab63d33ab224.why: Abathumela izithelo phesheya kanye namakhasimende empahla bathembela emisebenzini yokulayisha yamachweba, neziteringi ezine ezinikezwe itheku elinezinhlobonhlobo ngezikhathi eziphezulu.
paragraphs: Itheku leziqukathi laseKapa litshale izigidi ezingama-R83 (amaRandi ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezi-4.78) kuziteringi zeziqukathi eziyi-14 njengoba isizini yokuthunyelwa kwezithelo zaseNingizimu Afrika iqala. I-Transnet Port Terminals ithe le mishini isetshenziswa emikhunjini, emathangeni nasemakhreyini asendaweni.

Umphathi wetheku uNoxolo Thabatha uthe ama-hydraulic twist-lock eziteringi avikela iziqukathi futhi kuhloswe ngawo ukwehlisa ukulibaziseka kwemishini ngesikhathi kulayishwa imikhumbi. Amayunithi amane azosebenzela itheku laseKapa elinezinhlobonhlobo, elisekela itheku leziqukathi ngezikhathi zokuthumela eziphezulu.

Ethekwini leziqukathi, amahora okusebenza kwemikhumbi athuthuke ngo-15% unyaka wezimali ophele ngoMashi 2026, kuyilapho ukuguqulwa kwamaloli kwehle kusuka kumaminithi angu-52 kwaba yimizuzu engama-35. Imimoya enamandla eningizimu-mpumalanga ibiza itheku izinsuku zokusebenza ezingama-79 ngonyaka odlule; ngesikhathi sokuma kwesimo sezulu, amathekhu amabili azosebenzisa indawo yasendlini yaseBelcon ukuhlela ukunyakaza komhlaba nokwamukela iziqukathi ezibandayo.

34f37091f57e414efd3f.headline: Isiteshi sezulu sexwayisa ngezikhukhula zaseGauteng nemimoya eyingozi
34f37091f57e414efd3f.dek: Isexwayiso seZinga le-5 Eliwolintshi sihlanganisa izingxenye zesifundazwe, lapho izivunguvungu zingase zilethe imvula eningi, isichotho esincane nemimoya eyingozi ngoMgqibelo.
34f37091f57e414efd3f.why: Abashayeli nabahlali ezindaweni ezixwayisiwe bayancengwa ukuba bagweme imigwaqo nezifula ezikhukhumezile njengoba imvula eningi isongela imigwaqo, imijondolo namabhuloho.
paragraphs: Isiteshi sezulu saseNingizimu Afrika sikhiphe isexwayiso seZinga le-5 Eliwolintshi ngezivunguvungu ezinzima ezingxenyeni zaseGauteng ngoMgqibelo, mhla zingama-28 uNovemba. Isexwayiso esiphezulu sihlanganisa izindawo ezizungeze iGoli neEkurhuleni.

I-South African Weather Service ithe imvula eningi ingakhukhula imigwaqo, imijondolo namabhuloho, kuyilapho inani elikhulu lesichotho esincane nemimoya eyingozi kungalimaza ingqalasizinda. Incenge abantu abasezindaweni ezithintekile ukuba balandele izibuyekezo futhi bagweme imigwaqo nezifula ezikhukhumezile.

Isibikezelo sifuna imvula esabalele nezivunguvungu eGauteng. Abahlali baphinde belulekwa ukuba bafune indawo yokukhosela ngesikhathi sezivunguvungu, bavikele izinto zangaphandle ezingaxega futhi bahlale kude nezihlahla emimoyeni enamandla.

899927ee66ef947ee2f9.headline: Ingosi yekhomishini yamanzi iqondise ukulahleka kamasipala njengoba amanzi angenayo imali afinyelela ku-47.4%
899927ee66ef947ee2f9.dek: Isikhungo sezinsiza sihlanganisa amathuluzi ahloliwe, kuyilapho isici sokwabelana esihleliwe sizovumela imikhandlu ukuba idlulisele izindlela ezisebenze kumanethiwekhi ayo.
899927ee66ef947ee2f9.why: Izikhulu zikamasipala zumele zithole ukuthi ukulahleka kuvela yini ezindongeni noma ezinkingeni zokulinganisa nokukhokhisa, kanti ibhalansi yamanzi kazwelonke ilinganisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokomzimba ku-40.8%.
paragraphs: IWater Research Commission ithuthukisa ingosi yokusiza omasipala baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi babhekane namanzi angenayo imali, okuyibhalansi yamanzi kazwelonke yomnyango eyibeka ku-47.4%. Ikhomishini ihlonze izinsiza ezingama-84 zendawo yokubuthana, kusho usosayensi wocwaningo uLeonie Vorster kuwebinar eThekwini mhla zingama-25 uNovemba.

UVorster uthe isigaba esilandelayo sizovumela abasebenzisi ababhalisiwe ukuba babelane ngezindlela ezisebenze kumanethiwekhi abo. Ingosi ibisesigabeni sokuthuthukiswa cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi abanye omasipala sebeqale ukuyisebenzisa. Izohlangabezana nemihlahlandlela, amathuluzi kanye nolwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe obuhloliwe ensimini, kusho uchwepheshe wamanzi uDkt Manjusha Sunil.

Ibhalansi yamanzi kazwelonke, ethatha okuhloliwe koMnyango ka-2023 No Drop, ilinganisele ukulahleka kwamanzi ku-40.8%. Amanzi angenayo imali abuye ahlanganise izimpahla ezingakhiqizi mali; izikhulu zidinga ukwehlukanisa ukuvuza, okudinga ukulungiswa, kusuka ekufundeni okungalungile noma amaphutha okukhokhisa.
